n30242.name: AriMagic.exists_pos_root_of_limits
n30242.type_full:
∀ {f : Real → Real} {L : Real},
  ContinuousOn f (Set.Ici 0) →
    LT.lt 0 (f 0) → Filter.Tendsto f Filter.atTop (nhds L) → LT.lt L 0 → Exists fun x => And (GT.gt x 0) (Eq (f x) 0)

n30243.name: AriMagic.unique_solution_n
n30243.type_full:
∀ {i d r : Real},
  LT.lt 0 d →
    LT.lt 0 i →
      LT.lt 0 r →
        LT.lt d (HAdd.hAdd 1 (HDiv.hDiv 1 i)) →
          ExistsUnique fun n =>
            And (LT.lt 0 n)
              (have v := Inv.inv (HAdd.hAdd 1 i);
              Eq
                (HSub.hSub
                  (HMul.hMul d (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul r (HDiv.hDiv (HSub.hSub 1 (HPow.hPow v n)) i)) (HPow.hPow v n)))
                  (HAdd.hAdd
                    (HMul.hMul r
                      (HDiv.hDiv
                        (HMul.hMul v
                          (HAdd.hAdd
                            (HSub.hSub (HMul.hMul n (HPow.hPow v (HAdd.hAdd n 1)))
                              (HMul.hMul (HAdd.hAdd n 1) (HPow.hPow v n)))
                            1))
                        (HPow.hPow (HSub.hSub v 1) 2)))
                    (HMul.hMul n (HPow.hPow v n))))
                0)

n30250.name: annuity.id_mul_geom_sum_formula
n30250.type_full:
∀ (x : Real),
  Ne x 1 →
    ∀ (n : Nat),
      Eq (annuity.id_mul_geom_sum n x)
        (HDiv.hDiv
          (HMul.hMul x
            (HAdd.hAdd
              (HSub.hSub (HMul.hMul (↑n) (HPow.hPow x (HAdd.hAdd n 1))) (HMul.hMul (HAdd.hAdd (↑n) 1) (HPow.hPow x n)))
              1))
          (HPow.hPow (HSub.hSub x 1) 2))

n30251.name: annuity_equation_unique_solvability
n30251.type_full:
∀ {IY PMT PV FV : Real} {N : Nat} (hann : annuity_equation IY PMT PV FV N) (hPMT : GE.ge PMT 0) (hPV : LT.lt PV 0)
  (hFV : GT.gt FV 0) (hIY : GT.gt IY 0),
  And (∀ (hN : Ne N 0), And (Eq PMT (CPT_PMT IY PV FV N)) (Eq IY (CPT_IY hann hN hPMT hPV hFV ⋯)))
    (And (Eq PV (CPT_PV IY PMT FV N))
      (And (Eq FV (CPT_FV IY PMT PV N))
        (Ne (HSub.hSub (HMul.hMul FV (HDiv.hDiv IY 100)) PMT) 0 → Eq (↑N) (CPT_N IY PMT PV FV))))

n30253.name: eq_CPT_I_of_D
n30253.type_full:
∀ {n : Nat},
  GE.ge n 2 →
    ∀ {i : Real} {d r : Real},
      Membership.mem (Set.Ioo 1 ↑n) d →
        GT.gt r 0 → ExistsUnique fun i => And (GT.gt i (-1)) (annuity.duration_equation n i r d)

n30254.name: eq_CPT_N_of_D
n30254.type_full:
∀ {n : Nat},
  GT.gt (↑n) 0 →
    ∀ {i d r : Real} (hd : LT.lt 0 d) (hi : LT.lt 0 i) (hr : LT.lt 0 r) (hdi : LT.lt d (HAdd.hAdd 1 (HDiv.hDiv 1 i))),
      annuity.duration_equation n i r d → Eq (↑n) (CPT_N_of_D hd hi hr hdi)
